articles.summary: After doubling total GWP run rate through the first half of 2026, and growing revenue 23x from 2022 to 2025, Shepherd now adds Intact, a global provider of property and casualty insurance, as a capacity partner for primary and excess casualty, expanding Shepherd's capabilities.
articles.title: Shepherd Doubles GWP Run Rate in First Half 2026, Partners with Intact to Back U.S. Casualty Growth
